Exchanges.Text:
Good morning, Gate team-c.
Our sprint goal is: Customers can pay by card and failed payments retry automatically, and there are 6 days left in the sprint.

Daniel, is story 4 done with the idempotency keys, is story 3 done after picking the summary page back up, and is task 15 finished? Also, have you been able to help Maya Lin with bug 12, and what did you finish, what’s next, and what’s blocking you?
Yesterday I finished card tokenisation and shipped the payment status API version two. Today I'm adding idempotency keys to payment requests. Nothing blocking me.

Daniel, I’ve noted your commitment: yesterday you finished card tokenisation and shipped the payment status API version two, and today you’re adding idempotency keys to payment requests, with nothing blocking you.

Daniel, story 3, Customer payment plan summary page, has been Active for 4 days. Still on track?
Yes, it's on track. I'll pick the summary page back up as soon as the idempotency keys are in.
Daniel, for the summary page being on hold until the idempotency keys are in, who can help unblock this?
Yes, that's right. That's everything from me.
Daniel, task 15, Add structured logging to gateway client, has been Active for 4 days. Still on track?
Structured logging is nearly done. I'll finish it today.

Thank you, Daniel.

Maya, quick check on your earlier commitments: for story 5, you said “I’ll chase them today,” is that done, and for bug 12, you said “I’ll pair with him on the staging access today,” is that done? Then please share what you finished, what’s next, and whether anything is blocking you.

Yesterday I reviewed the settlement schema. Today I'm continuing the settlement file validation. I'm blocked on bug 12. The sandbox gateway keeps timing out, and I need access to the platform team's staging gateway.
Sorry to jump in, Maya, but we hit the same gateway timeouts last sprint when we upgraded the TLS library, and it took us days to track down.
Right, I think the root cause was the connection pool settings, so we should compare the gateway configuration between sandbox and staging, and also check whether the sandbox certificate was rotated.
Let’s take that offline and I will add it to the parking lot, and Maya, please carry on.
That's everything from me.
Maya, for bug 12 where the sandbox gateway keeps timing out and you need access to the platform team’s staging gateway, who can help unblock this?
Daniel can help. He fixed the same gateway timeouts last sprint, so I'll pair with him on the staging access today.

Maya, I’ve noted your commitment: I’ll pair with him on the staging access today.

Maya, story 5, Update PCI scan exceptions, has been Active for 4 days. Still on track?
The PCI scan exceptions are waiting on the security review. I'll chase them today.
Maya, I’ve noted the blocker and commitment: “The PCI scan exceptions are waiting on the security review. I'll chase them today,” and blockers will be flagged for follow-up.

Thanks, Maya.

Admin, is story 1 done, and is task 14 done? What did you finish, what’s next, and is anything blocking you?
Yesterday I finished the refund API tests.
Today I'm still working on the payment retry story.
No blockers.

Admin, I’ve noted your update.

task 14, Write retry load test, is past its due date. What is the new date?
It slept because the sandbox was down.
I should finish it tomorrow.
Admin, for the blocker where the sandbox was down and you’re aiming to finish it tomorrow, who can help unblock this?
Maya can help.
She's already chasing the platform team about the sandbox, so I'll sync with her after the stand-up.
Admin, I’ve noted your commitment: I’ll sync with her after the stand-up.
Yes, that's right.
That's everything from me.

We had blockers raised: one item is on track and will resume once idempotency keys are in, Maya is blocked on bug 12 due to sandbox gateway timeouts and needs access to the platform team’s staging gateway, the PCI scan exceptions are waiting on security review, and the sandbox was down. We also parked a side discussion about gateway timeouts between Daniel Park and Admin for offline follow-up. One flagged item wasn’t covered: task 19 is stale and at risk, and the owners will get a follow-up about it. Follow-ups, including any attendance-related ones if needed, are coming in Teams—thanks everyone.
